claimBoundary: Every listed board was opened individually at original detail. Mechanical receipts do not override Adam's rulings. New palette, citizenship, and boundary results are prototype-tool candidates, not production art admission; no current sprite is final.

reviews.finding: All six states read at proof and play scale. Resting is seated and rear view is a true back construction. The rear gauntlet and sword grip show no obvious malformed hand or broken contact in this return. Identity and taste still require Adam.
The combined four-dialect board is an index. It is not accepted as proof in place of the individual enclosure, path, road, and cliff boards below.
The original Blob47 dialect remains coherent across architectural islands, holes, corners, necks, stairs, diagonal contacts, and its all-shapes stress field.

Diagonal ridge trail, game-trail forks, woodland loop, and switchback renders remain continuous through sharp turns and diagonal joins. The organic jitter breaks sterile line regularity without pinching the route. All 256 eight-way masks are covered.

Meander, forks and dead ends, crossings and loop, and switchbacks and spurs read as a road rather than a wide path because shoulders and paired rut detail remain legible. All 16 cardinal masks are covered.

Escarpment, terraced switchback, mesa and outcrop, and ravine renders expose coherent shaded and striated faces in a dimetric height field. The proof exercises 16 cardinal transitions and four integer elevation bands.
